hero.headline: Community Partners
hero.subheadline: We believe in the power of community. From our humble beginnings at Cherry Creek Farmers Market to today, partnerships have been at the heart of everything we do.

partnershipTypes.title: How We Partner
partnershipTypes.subtitle: Building relationships that strengthen our community

types.description: We partner with event centers, breweries, and unique venues throughout Colorado.
Recurring partnerships with businesses for employee appreciation and client events.
Supporting local charities and community organizations with special pricing.

featuredPartners.title: Featured Partners
featuredPartners.subtitle: Some of the amazing organizations we work with

partners.name: Church Ranch Event Center
partners.description: Premier event venue in Westminster offering stunning mountain views and world-class amenities. We've partnered to provide exceptional catering for weddings, corporate events, and special celebrations.

partners.name: Table Mountain Event Center
partners.description: Golden's premier event destination with breathtaking views of Table Mountain. Our partnership delivers unforgettable culinary experiences for their exclusive events and celebrations.

partners.name: Cherry Creek Farmers Market
partners.description: Where it all began! Since 2010, we've been serving the Cherry Creek community with fresh, locally-sourced cuisine every Saturday morning during market season.

partners.name: New Terrain Brewing
partners.description: Golden's favorite craft brewery and our go-to beverage partner. Together we create the perfect pairing of craft beer and gourmet food truck cuisine for their taproom events.

partners.name: Denver Tech Center
partners.description: Serving Denver's bustling tech hub with weekly lunch service and corporate event catering. We fuel innovation with fresh, customizable bowl meals that keep teams productive.

partners.name: Buckley Space Force Base
partners.description: Proud to serve our military community at Buckley SFB. From family day events to unit celebrations, we bring restaurant-quality catering to those who serve our nation.

partners.name: Colorado Convention Center
partners.description: Denver's premier convention facility trusts Crock Spot for large-scale event catering. We've served thousands at trade shows, conferences, and exhibitions.

partners.name: Denver Botanic Gardens
partners.description: Partnering to bring delicious cuisine to garden events, summer concerts, and private celebrations surrounded by nature's beauty in the heart of Denver.

partners.name: Red Rocks Amphitheatre
partners.description: The world's most iconic outdoor venue. We provide pre-show catering and VIP experiences for concerts and events at this legendary Colorado landmark.

partners.name: University of Denver
partners.description: Feeding the future leaders at DU! From homecoming celebrations to faculty events and graduation parties, we bring campus events to life with fresh cuisine.

partners.name: Children's Hospital Colorado
partners.description: Supporting the amazing staff and families at Children's Hospital with appreciation events, fundraisers, and team celebrations throughout the year.

partners.name: Denver Art Museum
partners.description: Bringing culinary artistry to complement world-class visual art. We cater exhibition openings, member events, and private gallery experiences.

communityInvolvement.title: Giving Back
communityInvolvement.subtitle: Our commitment to making Denver a better place

items.title: Local Sourcing
items.description: We partner with local farms and vendors whenever possible to support our community.

items.title: Charity Events
items.description: Discounted catering for non-profit fundraisers and community benefit events.

items.title: Food Donations
items.description: Excess food from events is donated to local shelters and food banks.

items.title: Youth Employment
items.description: Providing job opportunities and training for young people in our community.

becomePartner.title: Become a Partner
becomePartner.description: We're always looking for great partners who share our values of quality, community, and exceptional service. Whether you're a venue, business, or organization, let's explore how we can work together.
